he current study
replicated the significant difference found in the rate of NOT alerts between treatment
formats (p ! .007). Additionally, the timing of NOT alerts created a more complex

suggest that clients in group therapy are more likely to alert as NOT during the course
of therapy when compared to clients in individual therapy.
